scope: Seven confirmed note-library defects and their runtime dependency advisories
fixed: Executable frontmatter engines removed from indexing, analysis, tags and Wiki import; metadata size and complexity bounded
Library reads and mutations validate physical ancestors and reject descendant junctions and symbolic links
Backup directories include full filenames and extensions; ambiguous legacy histories are retained and excluded from restoration
File and folder moves migrate backup histories with a synced rollback journal and startup recovery; orphan destination histories are rejected
HTTP and HTTPS export images are embedded with size, time, MIME and redirect limits
Text import preflights and stages the entire batch; publish failures undo newly created files
Mermaid upgraded to 11.16.1 and verified against the actual equal-range XY chart parser

windowsDirectoryMoves.finding: Recursive directory notifications can temporarily prevent backup directory renames; synchronous retry prevents notifications from settling
windowsDirectoryMoves.fix: Asynchronous bounded retry within the existing note-writer and index publication queues; physical paths and destination ownership checked on every attempt
verified: File and folder histories under a real recursive Windows watcher
Persistent backup rename failure restores the original note path and preserves histories
Failed tree-order publication restores note paths and histories
Injected interrupted move journal is recovered before startup indexing

dependencies.remainingAdvisories: Other dependencies were not comprehensively upgraded in this change; audit counts include build and development tooling
